groups.scope: Regular connected Kahler covering and deck quotient X; automorphic character and weight bundle; conformal connection; Gauduchon/co-closed Lee equivalence; Lee Bott--Chern class and class-C/balanced obstruction; ordinary and twisted potentials, constant normalization and chosen weight-bundle scale; Hopf Vaisman ordinary mass counterexample and fixed-Lee/twisted-class coupled equations. General pseudoeffectivity and volume uniqueness questions remain open.

Vaisman normalization s/(4pi), parallel Lee and holomorphic commuting Lee fields; basic transverse mass via horizontal degree; ordinary Hermitian uniqueness forces basic potentials and b=0 for invariant density; reconstruction has closed Killing dual and prescribed volume; common transverse kernel and bounded complete flows fix normalized Lee fields; transverse integral and maximum principle yield uniqueness. Rigidity uses both Chern--Ricci flatness and Gauduchon on the same metric.

Scalar Hopf radial normalization, elliptic fiber mass 2 and dimension m=n-1; explicit Lee/Gauduchon ODE, k<0 and Lee period; crossing direction plus integrals force strict ordering; invariant ODE interval and intermediate-value fixed point give existence; compact derivative bounds give continuous full period range; positive periodic twisted potential represents zero class; radial uniqueness does not assert uniqueness among all LCK metrics; nonconstant radial density obstructs Vaisman.

Conformal real Ricci formula in real dimension 2n and Chern--Ricci normalization; all divergence terms retained; integrated contracted Bianchi and Bochner identities eliminate Lee contractions; orthogonality gives norm Sminus squared equals half norm q squared; q=0 forces S=0, and real holomorphic Lee is equivalent to J-invariant symmetric derivative. Strictness excludes zero parallel Lee.

Explicit compact integer Heisenberg times circle quotient and integrable complex coframe; canonical bundle trivialization; closed Killing Lee dual gives Vaisman metric; flat conformal gauge has constant volume and q=-hsecond, explicit nonzero values; any flat metric in that conformal class has constant further scaling and stays non-Gauduchon. The manifold has a Vaisman metric, so this does not refute general manifold existence conjecture.

Ambient X explicitly changes to arbitrary connected compact complex n>=2. Kernel of Lee map is real parts of closed holomorphic one-forms; pointed pseudoeffective cone yields lineality kernel; Lamari and finite-dimensional annihilators give surjectivity and openness including zero space; cone strict duality; positive current class pullback/pushforward and general-position H1 comparison imply canonical bimeromorphic invariance; balanced/class-C cases and Hopf open half-line test linear cohomology pairings, not nonlinear masses.

Strongly Gauduchon closed mixed-type form criterion, dcexact power and LGzero; Hahn--Banach separation yields nonzero positive de Rham-exact (1,1) current iff no strongly Gauduchon metric; positivity and de Rham pairing imply uniform linear mass bound, weak compactness and closed pointed image cone; explicit free proper Calabi--Eckmann quotient has vanishing H1/H2/H5 but positive exact rank-two pullback; balanced elliptic example distinguishes strong Gauduchon, BC injectivity and nonlinear positive lower mass.
